template.event:
element("state"):SetInt( 0 )
element("state_1"):SetFloat( 0.75 ) element("state_2"):SetFloat( 3.5 ) element("state_3"):SetFloat( 0.75 )
element("timer"):SetFloat( 0.0 )
element("startY"):SetFloat( element("yOffset"):GetFloat() )
element("moving_state"):SetInt( 0 ) element("moving_state_1"):SetFloat( 0.25 ) element("movingTimer"):SetFloat( 0.0 )

local function clamp( value, max, min ) if ( value < min ) then return min end if ( value > max ) then return max end
return value end
local state = element("state"):GetInt()
if ( state < 1 ) then return end
local moving = element("moving_state"):GetInt() if ( moving == 1) then local currentMovingTimer = element( "moving_state_" .. moving ):GetFloat() local movingTimer = clamp( element( "movingTimer" ):GetFloat() + time, currentMovingTimer, 0 ) element( "movingTimer" ):SetFloat( movingTimer )
local y = lua_sys.cubicInterpolate( element("startY"):GetFloat(), element("startY"):GetFloat(), 0, 0, movingTimer / currentMovingTimer ) element("yOffset"):SetFloat( y )
if( movingTimer == currentMovingTimer ) then element("moving_state"):SetInt( 2 ) element("movingTimer"):SetFloat( 0.0 ) end
return end
local currentTimer = element( "state_" .. state ):GetFloat() local timer = clamp( element( "timer" ):GetFloat() + time, currentTimer, 0 ) element( "timer" ):SetFloat( timer )
if( state == 1 ) then local alpha = lua_sys.cubicInterpolate( 0, 0, 1.0, 1.0, timer / currentTimer )
element:GetComponent("bg")("alpha"):SetFloat( alpha ) element:GetComponent("title")("alpha"):SetFloat( alpha ) element:GetComponent("achievementImage")("alpha"):SetFloat( alpha ) end if (state == 3) then local alpha = lua_sys.cubicInterpolate( 1.0, 1.0, 0, 0, timer / currentTimer )
element:GetComponent("bg")("alpha"):SetFloat( alpha ) element:GetComponent("title")("alpha"):SetFloat( alpha ) element:GetComponent("achievementImage")("alpha"):SetFloat( alpha ) end
if ( timer == currentTimer ) then
if (state == 1) then element("state"):SetInt( 2 ) end
if (state == 2) then element("state"):SetInt( 3 ) end
if (state == 3) then element("state"):SetInt( 0 ) end
element( "timer" ):SetFloat( 0.0 ) end

touchComponent.event: local state = element("state"):GetInt() if ( state == 2 ) then element("state"):SetInt( 3 ) end
